text:
infra-monitor-bot: :rotating_light: Detected control-plane heartbeat gap in region eu-central3 — API 504s and LB healthchecks failing since 2582007880. Dash: https://internal.metrics/eu-central3/health
Maya K: paging @sre-oncall — visible in status page, assigning incident lead
sre-oncall: I'm on it, starting initial triage (control-plane, k8s, network overlays)
Raj P: checking peering — seeing mass route withdraws from peer-AS65321 around 2582007865, pings to control-plane nodes failing
Linh T: GPU autoscaler shows many pods Pending and nodes Marked NotReady; kubelet losing egress to control plane
Alex F: can we divert critical inference traffic to eu-west2? need quick approval to change routing policy
Maya K: approved. Execute traffic-shift playbook and notify support/cs. Put degraded SLA notice on status page
sre-oncall: Partial traffic shift started, lowering eu-central3 weight. Command run:
```
rdeploy routing adjust --region eu-central3 --weight 20 --reason "control-plane heartbeat gap"
```
Watching error rates and latency histograms now
infra-monitor-bot: new alarm — backend 502 spike in eu-west2, request latency + tail latency rising after partial shift
Raj P: spinning up extra VM-backed GPU capacity in eu-west2 (pool: dedicated-gpu-2). ETA ~5m for nodes to join cluster
Linh T: still seeing egress failures from eu-central3 worker subnets; suggest kubelet restart on control nodes to recover overlay routes. @sre-oncall can you run rolling restarts?
sre-oncall: initiating kubelet restart on cp-euc3-a and cp-euc3-b (rolling). Will monitor control-plane metrics and etcd replication
deploy-bot: Canary failover job job-2841 started, logs: https://internal.logs/job-2841
Maya K: I'll update status page and notify Customer Success with guidance for high-priority customers
sre-oncall: kubelet restarts completed, control-plane API responses returning intermittently. Keeping weight eu-central3=20% for 30m, then reassess. Opening incident INC-2026-045.
Raj P: eu-west2 capacity online, but note cost spike — adding billing tag and will add a cost note to the incident
Maya K: :thumbsup: Good triage. Next updates in 10 minutes unless anything regresses
